name: Rio de Janeiro
summary: Rio de Janeiro combines iconic beaches such as Copacabana and Ipanema with the backdrop of Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain, plus a vibrant cultural and nightlife. The cost of living is low by Western standards, which makes it attractive for nomads on a tight budget, but safety is a real concern: it is advisable to choose the neighborhood (Zona Sul) well and move with caution, especially at night. Fixed internet in Brazil is surprisingly fast thanks to the expansion of fiber optics.
